title: Evil Lives Here
description:

description:

title: Stranger Among Us
description:

West Virginia firefighter Chip and local nurse Alaina kindle a relationship while taking a paramedic class, but their smoldering romance ends in a blazing inferno that leaves several people dead and others heading to prison.

title: The Night That Didn't End

In Dayton, Ohio, a young mother goes missing after attending a party, and her identical twin becomes convinced there is something deeply sinister afoot.

title: The Night That Didn't End
description:

In the suburbs of Atlanta, Ga., a pregnant woman and her fiancé are kidnapped on the night before their baby shower and the fiancé's family receives ransom calls that same night.

title: The Night That Didn't End
description:
S02 E05 — John Doe 57
A tip from a missing persons network helps identify the body of a John Doe murder victim, leading investigators to unravel a dark tale of betrayal.

title: The Night That Didn't End
description:

In North Port, Fla., police receive a call reporting that a young mother has gone missing; in an effort to find her, detectives follow a trail of incoming 911 calls that reveal a heartbreaking story more horrific than they could have ever imagined.

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S03 E08 — Domestic Disturbance
With a new home and loving fiancé, single mother Lisa Filiaggi finally feels as though luck is on her side, then past troubles come back to haunt her and threaten to destroy all her future plans.

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S03 E09 — Into the Wild
In Montana, 22-year-old runner Kari Swenson is abducted by mountain men; when Swenson learns of their twisted plans, she realizes she must do everything in her power to escape or die trying.

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S03 E04 — Secret Rage
For 17-year-old Sarah Wisnosky, college is all about new experiences, so when she catches the eye of a flirty frat member, she's happy to play along. Then the college freshman discovers he's hiding a dark secret.

title: Your Worst Nightmare
description:
S03 E02 — Cabin in the Woods
The Millers always thought something was off when it came to their oldest son Steven, then he goes from strange to sinister, and there's no telling how far he will go to get his family's attention.

title: American Monster
description:
S11 E06 — If Only He Had a Heart
Tina Swor and partner John Dalton start a new life in Spirit Lake, Idaho; John's erratic behavior and love of guns plague the couple's fresh start; when Tina's best friend doesn't see her for days, she decides to call the cops.

title: American Monster
description:
S11 E03 — Breathe for Me Mom
There's nothing Brian and Cheri Hartman won't do for their only child, Scott, including helping to raise his kids after a divorce; Cheri and Brian dote on their grandbabies, and the close-knit family thrives until a betrayal changes everything.

title: American Monster
description:
S11 E07 — Success at Any Cost
Shirley Merritt is devoted to her family, especially her youngest son, Richard, but he wants to have the good life by any means possible; when bad choices lead to a prison sentence, Richard makes a deadly decision, and his secret is exposed.

title: American Monster
description:
S11 E08 — We're Looking at You Barbara
Barbara Pacheco spends years building both a family and a successful career; when the father of her children, Aldo Pacheco, becomes increasingly violent and unpredictable, Barbara is forced to make a decision that will end up costing everything.

title: American Monster
description:
S11 E05 — The Punisher
Brittany Steier devotes her life to being a mom and having a happy family; when the father of her children, Edward June Harris Jr, becomes increasingly violent and unpredictable, Brittany has to make a decision that will end up costing her life.

title: American Monster
description:

Michelle Rogers and Matt Terry are together and share a son, Matt, but he has a dark side that comes out when he drinks; his rage explodes, leaving Michelle fighting for her life; Matt serves prison time, but tragedy strikes again when he gets out.

A stripper who loves the lavish lifestyle her occupation affords her quits for her husband, only to get involved in something even more lucrative and dangerous.

Bored with his predictable life, a married professor falls for a woman requiring payment for her time; he soon finds her allure irresistible, causing his bills to skyrocket, but he doesn't learn his lesson until it's far too late.

description:

A woman marries her high school sweetheart but starts an affair with a co-worker soon after; her husband also develops a crush on someone at his work; while one relationship fizzles, the other sizzles, leading to an unbelievable killing.

title: Scorned: Fatal Fury
description:
S02 E10 — Sound and Fury
A Chicago salesman who fancies himself a car stereo mogul proposes to a beautiful stripper he meets at the club; she's not exactly wife material, and by the time he's ready to turn down the volume on the marriage, it's far too late.

title: Heart of Darkness
description:
S01 E02 — History of Violence
At first, it appears as though 50-year-old Edwardyne Williams has fallen victim to a random act of violence; however, as police dig deeper, they discover that her killer is someone who has been harboring a grudge against her for years.

title: Heart of Darkness
description:
S01 E05 — Murder in the Poconos
Benjamin Amato and Cheryl Kunkle's May-December romance grows complicated when Cheryl becomes pregnant; the former lovers soon square off in court, but the day before their final custody hearing, a murder changes everything.

title: Heart of Darkness
description:
S01 E01 — Lust for Murder
When Stacie Smith is found dead and an accusation that she has been unfaithful is written on the wall of the crime scene, police believe that a jealous lover is behind her brutal death; the evidence may be a ploy to frame the wrong man for the crime.

title: Forbidden: Dying for Love
description:

title: Forbidden: Dying for Love

A Texas woman enters into an affair with her daughter's grandfather, causing a major rift in the family and eventually leading to a bloody showdown.

A college student's new husband has a dark past that rears its ugly head and ends in a double homicide.
